briefdescription.para: Document store benchmark suite — DST-BM-01 through DST-BM-08.

detaileddescription.para: Covers serialization, list/read hot paths, update, remove, large-body persistence, and schema validation throughput for InMemoryDocumentStore and InMemoryDocumentSchemaEvolution.

Benchmark identifiers (Q3 2026 stabilization): DST-BM-01 PutThroughput — put() for 1000 sequential documents DST-BM-02 GetLatency — get() for pre-populated store with 1000 docs DST-BM-03 ListThroughput — list() for a collection with 1000 docs DST-BM-04 CountLatency — count() for a collection with 1000 docs DST-BM-05 UpdateThroughput — update() body replacement for 1000 existing docs DST-BM-06 RemoveThroughput — remove() for 1000 existing docs per iteration DST-BM-07 LargeBodyPut — put() with a 10 KB JSON body document DST-BM-08 SchemaValidationThroughput — validate() for 1000 docs against 10-field schema
Hard release gates (Q3 2026 — see RELEASE_GATES.md): GATE-DOC-05: put() throughput ≥ 100 000 ops/s GATE-DOC-06: get() mean latency proxy for p99 ≤ 100 µs

Measurement hygiene (see benchmarks/MEASUREMENT_HYGIENE.md):
All registrations use UseRealTime().
kDocCanonicalSeed = 42; std::mt19937 drives random document access.
1000 documents pre-populated in SetUp() provide stable read/update targets.
PauseTiming()/ResumeTiming() isolates per-iteration store reset for RemoveThroughput only.
benchmark::DoNotOptimize() applied to every result.
